newsitem.title: USA: Mail-Well sees strong sales, earns in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Mail-Well sees strong sales, earns in 1997.

text.p: Mail-Well Inc said Thursday it expects strong sales and earnings growth through the remainder of 1997 and beyond as a result of growth in its current operations.
The company also said the recently completed purchases of Murray Envelope, Griffin Envelope and Allied Printers should contribute to sales and earnings growth.
The company reported earnings per share of $0.35 compared to $0.20 for the same period a year ago.
Mail-Well operates more than 50 printing plants.
